subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): populate Langfuse trace-level input/output from model calls

question: Should existing `diagnostics.otel.captureContent` allow copied prompt/response content on Langfuse trace-level and root-observation surfaces, or should this PR add/narrow an explicit opt-in for root visibility?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but the visibility change moves already captured prompt/response content onto broader Langfuse UI/API surfaces, which is a security-boundary/product-policy choice for diagnostics owners.

options.title: Accept existing captureContent gate
options.body: After the lifecycle bug is fixed, merge with existing `captureContent` as the operator opt-in for root trace and root-observation I/O visibility.

options.title: Require narrower root-I/O opt-in
options.body: Keep model-call capture as-is but require an additional documented option before copying prompt/response content to root Langfuse surfaces.

options.title: Limit to trace-level attributes only
options.body: Populate only `langfuse.trace.input`/`langfuse.trace.output` and leave root observation `input.value`/`output.value` unchanged if the root node preview is too broad.

recommendation.title: Accept existing captureContent gate
recommendation.body: After the lifecycle bug is fixed, merge with existing `captureContent` as the operator opt-in for root trace and root-observation I/O visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent diagnostics content-safety and plugin security history makes this the best available routing owner for the visibility boundary choice.
